title: LU Decomposition
subtitle: LU decomposition splits A into two triangular matrices L (lower) and U (upper) where LU = A. Solving AX = C becomes two simple triangular problems: LE = C (forward substitution), then UX = E (back substitution). The notes work through the 3×3 manufacturing problem giving x₁=1, x₂=2, x₃=4.

topics.title: Finding L and U, then Solving in Two Stages

subtopics.title: Finding L and U, then Solving in Two Stages

content.text: L has 1s on the diagonal and the elimination multipliers below. U has 1s on the diagonal and the modified row values above. You find their entries by expanding LU = A term by term using the formulas from matrix multiplication.

items: L = [ 1 0 0 ] U = [ 1 u₁₂ u₁₃ ] [ l₂₁ 1 0 ] [ 0 1 u₂₃ ] [ l₃₁ l₃₂ 1 ] [ 0 0 1 ] l₁₁ = l₂₂ = l₃₃ = 1 (always, for both L and U diagonals) l₂₁ = a₂₁ u₁₂ = a₁₂ l₃₁ = a₃₁ u₁₃ = a₁₃

content.text: Then the remaining entries are found from: l₂₂·u₂₂ + ... = a₂₂ etc.
Find first column of L and first row of U — read directly from A
l₁₁ = 1 (diagonal, always) l₂₁ = a₂₁ = 2 l₃₁ = a₃₁ = 3 u₁₁ = 1 (diagonal, always) u₁₂ = a₁₂ = 3 u₁₃ = a₁₃ = 2
LU entry (2,2) must equal a₂₂ = 4: l₂₁·u₁₂ + l₂₂·1 = a₂₂ 2·3 + l₂₂ = 4 6 + l₂₂ = 4 l₂₂ = -2
LU entry (2,3) must equal a₂₃ = 3: l₂₁·u₁₃ + l₂₂·u₂₃ = a₂₃ 2·2 + (-2)·u₂₃ = 3 4 - 2·u₂₃ = 3 -2·u₂₃ = -1 u₂₃ = 1/2
LU entry (3,2) must equal a₃₂ = 4: l₃₁·u₁₂ + l₃₂·1 = a₃₂ 3·3 + l₃₂ = 4 9 + l₃₂ = 4 l₃₂ = -5
LU entry (3,3) must equal a₃₃ = 7: l₃₁·u₁₃ + l₃₂·u₂₃ + l₃₃·1 = a₃₃ 3·2 + (-5)·(1/2) + l₃₃ = 7 6 - 5/2 + l₃₃ = 7 l₃₃ = 7 - 6 + 5/2 = 7/2 = 3.5
Write out the final L and U matrices

Why use LU? If you have the same matrix A but need to solve it for 10 different right-hand sides, LU means you decompose once and run 10 cheap substitutions. Redoing full Gaussian each time would be 10× the work. This is why engineering software prefers LU.

Common mistake — Mixing up L and U: L is the lower triangle (values below the diagonal come from the elimination multipliers). U is the upper triangle (values above the diagonal come from the modified row entries after scaling). Both have 1s on the main diagonal itself.
